QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_7

question.text: A ZCZP bond prospectus under SEBI ICDR Reg 292C requires a minimum tenure of:

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Under SEBI ICDR Regulation 292C, the ZCZP bond has a minimum tenure of three years. This informs the SIA's engagement horizon — baseline, mid-line and end-line assessments must span at least 3 years for a ZCZP-funded programme. **The Trap:** 1 and 2 years are too short under the regulation. 5 years is beyond the stated minimum (though ZCZPs can be longer). **Cross-Exam Context:** Same 3-year tenure referenced in III-A / III-C (Compliance) SSE chapters and XIX-A AIF (Category I AIF tenure parallels). **Assessor's Pro-Tip:** Align your SIA engagement plan with the ZCZP tenor — schedule baseline at issuance, mid-line at year-1.5 and end-line at year-3 (immediately before maturity).
